svg.title: mREDAC architecture overview
svg.desc: Block diagram showing one mREDAC module holder with three clusters connected through one shared T-Block. C-Block routed lanes 8 through 31 feed the T-Block, and T-Block outputs feed destination I-Block inputs. C-Block local lanes 0 through 7 bypass the T-Block and feed the same-cluster I-Block directly. M-Block outputs feed back to U-Block inputs. Frontplane signals connect to Cluster 0 lanes 28 through 31.
svg.text: Three repeated clusters share one T-Block: C-Block routed lanes 8..31 enter the T-Block, and T-Block outputs feed destination I-Block inputs.
C-Block output lanes 8..31 into shared T-Block
T-Block output to destination I-Block input
M-Block outputs feed back to U-Block inputs
